title: Ice cream and drowning rise together

probes.question: Ice cream sales and drownings rise together. Which explanation fits best?
options: Drowning makes people buy ice cream
Something else, like hot weather, is linked to both
Nothing can be concluded about any link, ever

probes.question: True or false: a confounding variable is a third factor that affects both of the things being compared.

image.alt: A hand holding an ice cream cone on a boardwalk by the sea under a blue sky.

body.claim: Two things can rise together without one causing the other.
body.why: As ice cream sales rise, so do drowning deaths, but ice cream does not cause drowning. The example misses the time of year and temperature, which are linked to ice cream sales. A hidden factor that affects both things is called a confounding (or lurking) variable.
